Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

keys.description: Every witness identity the service holds, ordered by createdAt. Empty when it holds none.

Response.title: WebVH Witness Key List — response payload

did.description: The witness identity's DID (for example a `did:key`) — the value a did:webvh log names in its `witness` parameter, and the controller of the key that signs its proofs.

label.description: Operator-chosen display label. Untrusted free text. Absent when none was given.

proofsSigned.description: How many witness proofs this identity has signed.

witnessId.description: The witness service's identifier for this identity. Opaque to the requester.
